lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's fifteen? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 15? Nope!

lines.text: Fifteen squares, in rows of five, four, three, two, and one.
lines.caption: 15 squares, in rows of 5, 4, 3, 2, and 1.

lines.text: How many rectangles of any size are in it? Squares count too.
lines.caption: How many rectangles of any size are in it? Squares count too.

lines.text: Each rectangle is set by its top-right and bottom-left squares.
lines.caption: Each rectangle is set by its top-right and bottom-left squares.

lines.text: Top-right in column three, row two? The bottom-left has three times two spots. Six rectangles!
lines.caption: Top-right in column 3, row 2? The bottom-left has 3 times 2 spots. 6 rectangles!

lines.text: Write column times row in every square, then add up each column.
lines.caption: Write column times row in every square, then add up each column.

lines.text: Fifteen, twenty, eighteen, twelve, five. That's seventy rectangles!
lines.caption: 15, 20, 18, 12, 5. That's 70 rectangles!

lines.text: Fifteen was the trap: just the little squares.
lines.caption: 15 was the trap: just the little squares.

lines.text: Did you get seventy? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 70? Tell me below!
